\begin{tabular}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash\hspace{0pt}}p{0.155\linewidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash\hspace{0pt}}p{0.425\linewidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash\hspace{0pt}}p{0.387\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{Element} & \textbf{CV5 reads (cv5v2 screens, cv5v3 rows)} & \textbf{E1 final opening \#8} \\
\midrule
Headline & Crack relF1@2 with relP@2 and relR@2; Tolerance 2 px & crack relF1@2 at OP-A \\
Strict crack IoU & relF1@2 decides; strict crack IoU is printed with its convention band and decides nothing; convention band $\pm$0.019 = the largest shift of a strict-IoU contrast when the same predictions are re-scored on the 1-px centreline, the v1.1 and the 3-px labels & printed with the convention band $\pm$0.019, decides nothing \\
Operating points & OP-A (argmax) and OP-W (width-matched) decide. OP-F is printed and decides nothing. & OP-A only, a stated deviation from protocol 5.4 \\
Interval & Two-stage group bootstrap, module groups (285 on cv5v3, 330 on cv5v2), then one seed per fold and arm; 2,000 draws; 95\% percentile & seed-aware two-stage bootstrap: the 71 clusters are drawn with replacement, then for each arm independently 5 models are drawn with replacement from its 5; 2,000 draws; 95\% percentile interval \\
Margin M & M = max(0.01, 2 x SE of the A/\allowbreak{}A contrast), per machine; cv5v2, 532 cells: training machine 0.010 for crack IoU, relF1@2, mIoU-R13, 0.049 for inactive IoU; second machine 0.010, 0.054 & M = 0.010 (the protocol's relF1@2 margin on [the training machine], section 5.4; fixed now, not re-estimated on E1) \\
A/\allowbreak{}A of the deciding read & cv5v3 PF \{5,6\} v \{7,8\}, 532 cells: relF1\_\allowbreak{}2 delta $-$0.0002 SE 0.0037 M 0.0100 & A/\allowbreak{}A C1 \{7,8\} $-$ \{5,6\} (descriptive): relF1@2 +0.0022 [$-$0.0425, +0.0507], SE +0.0225 \\
A gain counts if & It counts only if it holds at OP-A and at OP-W inside the width band, with delta at least M and the 95\% interval above 0 & CONFIRMED: Delta $\geq$ M, lower end of the 95\% interval $>$ 0, and every guard G1 to G4 passes \\
Width guard & pass band 0.85 to 1.15 x the baseline's, pooled and per source with at least 40 cells (ARTS, BMRK, CFVS, CSIR) & G1 width, pooled: in 0.85 to 1.15; G2 width per source with $\geq$ 40 cells in E1: CSIR (101 cells) only \\
False crack px guard & false crack px on crack-free cells against PF (max 1.5) & G3: C2 $\leq$ 1.5 x C1 \\
mIoU-R13 guard & allowed drop 0.0100 & G4: Delta $\geq$ $-$0.010 \\
Inactive IoU & promotes no trained arm at 2 seeds; in the TTA read a guard with allowed drop 0.0462 (532 cells) & Inactive IoU is reported, never decides \\
Seeds & Screen = 2 seeds; table row = 5 seeds & seeds 5 to 9 per arm \\
Smallest detectable effect (power 0.8) & relF1@2 0.0087 / 0.0071 / 0.0055 at 2 / 3 / 5 seeds (cv5v2) & derived (not printed by any read): MDE = 2.80 x SE = 2.80 x 0.0265 = 0.0742, two-sided 0.05, power 0.80, normal approximation; SE = the printed seed-aware SE of P (T8 note) \\
Multiplicity & One pre-declared primary per arm & one primary contrast; prior looks: test50 18 counted openings; E1 7 registered openings (3 looks at one contrast) \\
